column1: # Rows db.tchar.psiblast.* (line RG-KB item 9(b)): psiblast refuses databases whose stored definition-line titles hold bytes outside ' ' to '~' in every format (including outfmt 8, 9 and 11), because NCBI's psiblast also reads titles during PSSM construction and for unpruned hit lists before PruneSeqalign (TitleReads::of_outfmts returns Reports for RequestKind::Psiblast); except for a query batch that ends at a header NCBI cannot read (rows dmg.*: 803.7 posts for the titles read before the unreadable header, then NCBI's error, in any format, for both 1-round and multi-round runs).
